name: ask_owner
description: Ask the owner one short question and wait for the answer.

name: finish
description: The task is done. Give the owner the full result.

result.description: The answer, plan, shortlist or draft, ready to use.

name: wait
description: Come back to the task after some days.

note.description: What happens then, in a few words.

name: hand_back
description: The rest needs the owner. Say why and what to do.

reason.description: Why, and the owner's next step.

name: remember
description: Keep something about the owner for later tasks: a preference, a goal, a fact about their life. Use it when it will help next time, not for details of this task. The owner can see and delete everything you keep.

text.description: One short sentence about the owner, in the third person: "Prefers email to phone calls".

kind.description: fact: the owner just said it. guess: your own reading of what they said or did.

confidence.description: Guesses only: how sure you are.

evidence.description: Where it comes from, in a few plain words: "You said so in this task".

topic.description: One of the topics in the first message, if it falls under one. Leave it out otherwise.

name: propose_event
description: Put an event in the owner's calendar. It ends your turn: the owner sees the event and adds it with one tap, or says no. Use it when the plan has a date and time worth blocking.

title.description: Short, as it should read in the calendar: "Dinner with Ana".

start.description: Owner's local time, 2026-11-20T19:00. A date alone, 2026-11-20, makes an all-day event.

end.description: Same format. Leave it out for an hour (or one day when all-day).

notes.description: Anything worth having at hand then: an address, a booking reference, what to bring.

name: propose_reminder
description: Add a reminder to the owner's Reminders. It ends your turn: the owner adds it with one tap, or says no. Use it for something only they can do, by a date.

title.description: What to do, as a short instruction: "Book Sintra palace tickets".

due.description: Owner's local time, 2026-11-20T09:00, or a date alone. Leave it out for no date.

name: propose_errand
description: Start an errand with a company: cancelling, getting a refund, disputing a charge or complaining. It ends your turn. Once the owner says yes, an errand agent writes to the company by email, shows every email for approval, follows up, and closes only with the company's written confirmation. Use it when the task needs someone to deal with a company in writing.

company_name.description: The company, as it calls itself.

company_email.description: The company's own email address for this. If you don't know it, ask the owner or find it on the company's own website first.

goal.description: What counts as done, in one sentence: "Membership cancelled from the next billing date, confirmed in writing, no further payments".

facts.description: What the owner told you that the company needs or that helps: dates, amounts, what happened.

account_ref.description: The account, member or order number, if the owner gave it.

will_not.description: What the owner won't accept, like "a discount instead of cancelling".
